what: Sun Life Financial is a Canadian insurer and asset manager. It sells life, health and group benefits insurance in Canada and the United States, manages money through MFS and SLC Management, and has a large and growing business across Asia.
customers: Canadian and US individuals and employers, institutional investors in its funds, and insurance customers across Asia.
money: MFS mutual funds and SLC alternative asset management
individual and group insurance and wealth
group benefits and dental, including Medicaid dental
insurance in Hong Kong, the Philippines, India and Vietnam
moat: The group benefits business in Canada and the US, where employer relationships renew year after year, alongside asset management fees that need no insurance capital.
risks: US dental and group benefits claims have run higher than expected
MFS has seen persistent fund outflows
Insurance accounting makes reported revenue volatile
Only one analyst covers it in this data and the target implies downside
opportunities: Asian insurance sales grow faster than in developed markets
A dividend yield near 4% with a strong capital position
watch: US group benefits claims experience and MFS net flows.
